{{Top}}
The '''Gotal Assembly for Separation''' was a [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Politics/Legends|political]] party on [[Antar 4/Legends|Antar 4]] that advocated joining the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]. The [[Roshu Sune/Legends|Roshu Sune]] were a radical splinter-group of the Assembly.
